01. Each open position has specific attachment requirements in order to be considered by the hiring committee. If the attachment directions are not followed, your application will not be considered. The required attachments for this position are: • Cover Letter; • Resume; • Diversity Statement (see instructions in Additional Information section); • Professional Reference List (see instructions in Additional Information section); • Unofficial Transcripts. Have you attached the correct required documents to your application? Options: Yes | No
